title: A Learning Algorithm for Boltzmann Machines
summary: David H. Ackley, Geoffrey E. Hinton, and Terrence J. Sejnowski published "A Learning Algorithm for Boltzmann Machines" in Cognitive Science in January 1985. The paper describes a general parallel search method based on statistical mechanics and a learning rule for modifying connection strengths to incorporate task-domain knowledge.
